notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: Added drag select and also the ability to make custom models have physics. All new prefabs from the game have also been added.

notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed shield not exporting correctly
Fixed importing not working correctly
Hopefully fixed properties toggles all turning off
Fixed scale snapping not following snap settings

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed the dark plank set, made it selectable.
Fixed duplicate items.
Fixed scale inputs in properties not working correctly. 
Fixed the loader throwing errors when someone joins.

Additions

Added undo to arrow nudging.
Added the ability to switch to the unused axis with ctrl while arrow nudging.
